$comment: The rich-text grammar contract shared by @comvi/core, @comvi/typegen (readMessage) and the platform's parser. js-sdk owns this file; the platform keeps a sha256-checked copy.
render: the message rendered with `values` and, for every tag name, a handler that returns `[name:` + its children joined + `]`; null when the message does not compile (it renders its key).

schema: what the generated types ask for. params as readMessage reports them; tags lists CLOSED tags only, ordered by the opening of each name's first closed occurrence. null for a message that does not compile.

error: null, or `syntax` when the message does not compile. unclosed: how many never-closed opening tags the message has (each renders as its own text and is reported once as a development warning); 0 when the message does not compile.
depthLimit: the height of the compiled tree a message may have. Each ICU sub-message level and each closed tag adds one; a never-closed tag is text and adds nothing.
